title: Choosing which state’s law governs
summary: Choice of law identifies which jurisdiction’s substantive law governs a claim. This is separate from whether a court has authority over the case and parties.
notes: Jurisdiction over the defendant or the class does not alone authorize application of the forum’s law to every transaction. A contractual choice-of-law clause also requires its own scope and validity analysis.

sections.Meaning: Choice of law identifies which jurisdiction’s substantive law governs a claim. This is separate from whether a court has authority over the case and parties.
sections.How to work through the question: In a diversity action, consider the forum state’s conflicts rules as discussed with Klaxon, and account for any relevant transfer doctrine. In a nationwide class, apply Shutts’s separate constitutional limits on selecting one state’s law for all claims.
